title: [CRY-18] did:webvh split-view and rollback are unaddressed; "auditable without trusting the organiz
description: Review finding CRY-18: did:webvh split-view and rollback are unaddressed; "auditable without trusting the organization" is overstated (lens CRY). Location: spec/02-identity.md:23, spec/02-identity.md:255, spec/12-security.md:135. Fix: 02:23 and 12:135 claim that the organization "cannot rewrite or hide the entry without producing an invalid history". Hash chaining prevents an invalid single history. It does not prevent serving a different valid fork, signed with the org's own update key, to a targeted resolver, or serving a stale prefix. 02:241's conflict rule only helps a resolver that sees both entries. A grep finds no "witness" or "watcher" anywhere in spec/, although did:webvh v1.0 defines both for this purpose. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Decision implemented: spec/02-identity.md §2.1 l20 table + l26 "Witnesses" (CO-provisioned did:webvh MUST use >=1 org-independent witness, clients MUST verify; individuals MAY; weaker guarantee stated); log entries carry witness proofs l297/l396/l438/l474; spec/12-security.md §12.7.3 l142 split-view
